title: P15.9 owner-action HTTP/UI seams + P16-A Brain Context Aggregator
description: Step 0 (P15.9): owner-scoped POST routes /api/vnext/objectives/:id/{progress,evidence,amend}. Owner proof is ONLY the trusted x-operator-id header (canonicalized once to operator:<id>); a body-declared owner/verifier is never authority — the evidence verifier is always the header-derived actor so assertOwnerVerifier enforces actor === owner_authority_id in the service. All semantics stay inside ObjectiveAuthorityService. accountBudget is deliberately NOT exposed (no assertOwner — cost-pipeline seam). UI: api.ts wrappers + ObjectiveDetail owner actions (measurement/evidence/amend) with exact-body idempotent retry + KPI-verifier grants card; grant+wake atomicity unchanged. Measurement is owner-attested via the owner-verifier seam — UI never mints verified state or sends a verifier field. Step 1 (P16-A ms1): brain-context.ts BrainContextService.contextFor — the Brain's only canonical read surface. Read-only by construction: strict reads delegate to the existing ObjectiveCockpitService composition; zero puts/events/model calls (B7). Owner-gated FAIL_CLOSED_BRAIN_AUTHORITY/SCOPE; tamper propagates strict-read errors (B2); broken CAS artifacts drop+report, never trusted (B4); business isolation (B5). Bounded via store.withReadBudget — typed PROOF_LIMIT on exhaustion, never silent truncation (B6). Deterministic context_digest stable iff canonical state unchanged, asof excluded (B1). Unscoped memory/experience report typed SCOPE_BINDING_ABSENT gaps (P17 prerequisite). Library-only — no server/UI Brain wiring this milestone.
